R7rl6RooLasexlVJ.description: APPROXIMATION: canon text is '+ (1 + tier) PER ACTION SPENT' on a weapon/unarmed hit; modeled here as a single (1+tier) add (the 1-action case) to physical-weapon damage types. Over-applies to any impact/keen/spirit damage, not only weapon Strikes — verify in play.
